dedupe_keys.name: aed設置箇所一覧 公共施設 evacuation shelters and public facilities

description: AED設置箇所一覧(公共施設) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 延岡市. 延岡市内のAED設置箇所の一覧です。 延岡市関連施設のみ掲載しています。. Coverage: 延岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 延岡市. Its tags are AED, 健康, 公共施設, 医療, 救急. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2020-12-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
